about: Most seconds (and MB the process may hold) for each case of python -m modeler perf; CI fails above them. About five times what a CI runner takes, so only a change that makes something several times slower trips them. Measured 2026-11-19 on a 4-core Linux machine (full): build plate 0.30, import STEP 0.15, pick faces 0.01, drawing 0.24, save 0.001, open 0.28, long history 5.2, rebuild after edit 5.2; big assembly 0.86 (1000 bolt copies built and meshed, measured 2026-11-25; 3.3 before the copies shared one mesh).
